posts.title: Will autism get better or worse with age?
posts.description: Parents and caregivers of autistic kids often wonder if autism gets better with age. Wanting your kid to fit in and be healthy is normal, but society conflates autism as being abnormal. But…”normal” isn’t static. posts.title: “You don’t look autistic”
posts.description: Non-autistic people often say, “You don’t look autistic,” because they are surprised to find out I’m autistic, have been conditioned to think autism = bad, think it’s a compliment, or another reason.
